references.text: Paul quotes directly from Deuteronomy 30:12 to explain righteousness by faith. He uses the text that no one needs to ascend into heaven to bring Christ down, because salvation is already near through faith.
Proverbs poses similar rhetorical questions about who has ascended into heaven, pointing to God's wisdom and power that surpass human ability.
Isaiah describes God's word coming down from heaven and accomplishing its purpose, which connects to the idea that God's command is not inaccessible in heaven but given to people.
Jesus says that no one has ascended into heaven except the One who descended from heaven, the Son of Man. This relates to the question of who can ascend into heaven.
Paul writes about Christ who descended and ascended, using similar language about ascending and descending from heaven as in Deuteronomy 30:12.
